messages:
alex: Noticed console analytics conflating fallbacks into main row when saved-view groups by route. small repro below.
julie: Reproed. The saved-view SQL groups by route_id only. Fallbacks to quantized variants get merged.
sam: UX impact: latency/quality graphs look noisy and customers ask about token counts.
productops: Proposal: add optional telemetry keys `served_model_variant` and `fallback_reason`, default null. Console adds a toggle "split by served model".
alex: Important: do not change billing; billing_model stays authoritative. New keys optional to avoid breaking consumers.
julie: Implementation: backend emits optional keys; ingestion indexes served_model_variant as low-card cardinality. Console shows extra column and small "fallback" pill when fallback_reason present.
ci-bot: Integration tests failing in console-grouping: tests/test_view_group.py::test_split_by_model -> AssertionError expected 2 got 3
sam: I'll update tests and add a canary feature flag. Productops, timeline?
productops: Aim for Tue canary 10% routes, release note & help center snippet ready.
alex: Thanks, pairing julie/sam on PR. Ping when CI green.
